config.baseline_selection: lowest tuning median latency qualifying at 95% tuning recall under the same storage budget
config.tuning_guard_note: 95% empirical tuning is a conservative selection guard for a 90% test target, not a population-recall certificate.
config.posting_compression: unique (fingerprint,parent) per table for every indexed method
